## extractLibFiles() function

Extracts lib file contents from a TypeScript installation.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare function extractLibFiles(_typescript: typeof ts, libNames: string[]): Map<string, string>;
```

## Remarks

This function locates lib files by finding the TypeScript installation directory and reading the lib files from there. This approach: - Uses the exact TypeScript version the caller provides - Doesn't require bundling large lib files - Supports any TypeScript version and configuration
